subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp accept the narrow all-unmentioned-group `suppressTyping` mitigation, or wait for the broader visible-delivery typing boundary?
rationale: Both paths reduce false WhatsApp typing indicators, but tests cannot decide the user-visible tradeoff where proactive unmentioned visible replies lose their typing flash.

options.title: Rebase the narrow mitigation
options.body: Adapt this PR to current main's `conversationKind` and group-mention metadata while preserving explicit-command, mentioned-group, and direct-chat typing behavior.

options.title: Prefer the visible-delivery boundary
options.body: Pause this branch only if maintainers choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 as the canonical structural path after resolving its API and compatibility risks.

options.title: Keep current behavior for now
options.body: Leave automatic unmentioned group turns with current typing behavior until a live repro or UX decision raises priority.

recommendation.title: Rebase the narrow mitigation
recommendation.body: Adapt this PR to current main's `conversationKind` and group-mention metadata while preserving explicit-command, mentioned-group, and direct-chat typing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns the overlapping visible-delivery typing PR and has merged WhatsApp inbound-dispatch history, so they are the best available owner for the UX boundary choice.
